701480.t: From ἀπο- (ăpo-, “away, off”) + κεφαλή (kephalḗ, “head”) + -ίζω (-ĭ́zō, denominative verb suffix).

701458.t: Etymology tree Proto-Indo-European *h₂ep Proto-Indo-European *-o Proto-Indo-European *h₂epó Proto-Hellenic *apó Ancient Greek ἀπό (ăpó) Ancient Greek ἀπο- (ăpo-) Proto-Indo-European *dʰeh₁- Proto-Indo-European *dʰédʰeh₁ti Ancient Greek τίθημι (títhēmi)…

701438.t: From ἀπο- (ăpo-, “from”) + δείκνυμι (deíknūmĭ, “to point out, show”).

701453.t: From ἀποδίδωμι (apodídōmi) + -σις (-sis). Cognate with Mycenaean Greek 𐀀𐀢𐀉𐀯 (a-pu-du-si).

701417.t: From ἄπληστος (áplēstos, “insatiable, greedy”) + -ία (-ĭ́ā, abstract noun suffix), ultimately from πίμπλημι (pímplēmi, “to fill”).

701439.t: From ἀποδείκνυμι (apodeíknūmi, “to show, display”) + -σις (-sis, verbal noun suffix).

701418.t: From ἀ- (a-, not) + πίμπλημι (pímplēmi, “to fill full, satisfy, satiate”) + -τος (-tos).

701409.t: From the same substrate root as ἄπιον (ắpĭon, “pear”) and Latin pirum (“pear”).

701408.t: From ἀπο- (apo-) + the root -η(ν)- (-ē(n)-) found in πρανής (prānḗs, “prone”) and ἐνηής (enēḗs, “gentle, amiable”).

701470.t: From ἀπο- (apo-, back again) + καθίστημι (kathístēmi, to set, place, constitute, appoint).

701493.t: From ἀποκρίνω (apokrī́nō, “to separate”) + -σις (-sĭs) and ἀπο- (apo-, “from, off”) + κρίσις (krísis, “decision”).
